title: WARN notices
description: One row per layoff or closure notice: company, state, city, workers affected, notice and layoff dates, type, and a link to the notice where the state publishes one.

notices.title: Layoff and closure notices
notices.description: Company, state, city, county, address, workers affected, closure or layoff, permanent or temporary, notice, received and layoff dates, days until layoff, industry, reason, major flag, notice link.

summary.title: Run summary
